what: College split: the measured plant tops on the bank between the carriageways (rows v1172-1444), and the raw lidar's non-ground returns there as a coverage check

frame.what: Lake Murray engine frame = data/centerline.local.json: x east, z north (m); y = NAVD88 - 100.8
frame.projection: shrub_heights.Track (the lm-shrub tool's own code, imported): UTM EPSG 6340 <-> EPSG:4326 by pyproj, x = (lon - lon0) * m_lon, z = (lat - lat0) * m_lat, WGS84 series at lat0; the same as job1_college_lidar.py
frame.tops_npz_frame: x, z = this frame (shrub_heights.Track.to_local of E, N); E, N = UTM EPSG 6340
frame.station_offset: v = the centreline vertex whose tangent foot is nearest (|along| smallest of the 4 nearest); offset_m = (p - P_v) . n_v, + = left of travel (v increasing) = west on College northbound (job1_college_lidar.py offset_doc; college_edges.json offset_sign); n_v checked against college_xsec.lidar.g10.json nx, nz to 5.0e-07
frame.centreline_md5_note: centerline.local.json of f0c35e1f = the lm-shrub job's = lm-round2's (md5 identical)

method.bank: [from file] the band between nb_inner_smooth_m and sb_inner_smooth_m (college_edges.json, commit f0c35e1f) on every row v1172-1444; polygon = the ribbon P_v + nb_inner * n_v (v up) then P_v + sb_inner * n_v (v down), straight between rows; point-in-polygon = shrub_heights.inside
method.bank_rows: [from file] v1172-1444 (README 'the main island reads from v1172 to v1444'; college_design.json ISLAND)
method.tops: [measured, from lm_shrub.tops.npz] every top inside the polygon whatever its flags; h = second-highest return in the 3x3 0.5 m cells over the shrub mosaic ground, crown = 8 rays (the tool's [invented] H_MIN 0.3, TOP_R 1.0, EDGE_FRAC 0.5, RISE_M 0.15, RAY_MAX_M 6.0, SOLID_ROUGH 0.08, GROUND_FAR 3.0)
method.flags: solid / plant / stratum = the npz's own; ground_far = gdist > 3.0 m (shrub_heights GROUND_FAR [invented])
method.y_ground: [measured] the shrub mosaic ground (median class 2 per 1 m, gap-filled 1-16 m) at the top, bilinear, - 100.8; y_top = y_ground + h
method.in_design_bank: [from file] also inside college_design.json's inner edges (smoothed, bridged) on the same rows
method.raw_counts: [measured] D24 returns not withheld, class 1 (3/4/5 are not used in D24) inside the polygon, height over a TIN (Delaunay, linear) of the corridor's class-2 returns; '_mosaic' = over the shrub mosaic ground instead (the ground the tops were found on)
method.bins: [from the request] 10 rows by nearest vertex; area = the ribbon's quads from row v to v+1
method.cells: [invented] 1 m cells whose centre is inside the polygon; 'covered' = 2+ returns >= 0.3 m (the tool's own top rule at 1 m); 'no top within 3 m' = covered cells farther than 3.0 m [invented] from any top of the npz (any flag): where the tops file may have missed plants
method.reads: [invented] bare = no 1 m cell with 2+ returns >= 0.5 m; sparse = under 10 %% of cells with a return >= 0.5 m; planted = under 50 %%; dense = 50 %% or more

bank.edges_note: college_edges.json's inner edges are 9-station medians of 0.5 m cells; README: single stations misread under trees (the middle reads up to 17 m at v1297), so the polygon is wider than the real bank around v1295-1301 and v1310-1322 (nb_inner -8 to -12.5 m against about -6.5 m either side); in_design_bank marks the tops inside the design's bridged edges

existing_bank_spots_vs_tops.what: college_plants.report.json's spots on 'the bank' against the nearest top of the npz (a registration check: the measured ones came off the same lidar)
